entities.name: Willie "Big Eyes" Smith
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Willie Lee "Big Eyes" Smith was an American electric blues vocalist, harmonica player, and drummer. He was best known for several stints with the Muddy Waters band beginning in the early 1960s.
